methodology_name: Dristik Evidence-Based Check & Curve Scoring Architecture

semantics.measured: >= 60% of subsection check weights measured; included in overall rollup.
semantics.partial: 30% - 59.99% measured; included in rollup but flagged as PARTIAL.
semantics.not_measured: < 30% measured; excluded from rollup and active weights renormalized.

gates.reason: Catastrophic indexation defect (sitewide noindex, Disallow: /, or 5xx) blocks site discovery.

checks.name: Robots.txt RFC 9309 Valid Syntax
checks.description: Robots.txt parses correctly according to RFC 9309 without fatal syntax errors.

checks.name: XML Sitemap Valid URLs & Matching Canonicals
checks.description: Proportion of sitemap URLs that return HTTP 200 and match self-canonical.

checks.name: Indexable Sample URL Share
checks.description: Share of crawled sample URLs that return 200, lack noindex, and self-canonicalize.

checks.name: Internal Click Depth <= 3
checks.description: Share of sample URLs accessible within 3 clicks from homepage.

checks.name: Hreflang Return Tags & Valid Codes
checks.description: If multilingual, share of hreflang tags with valid ISO codes and reciprocal return tags.

checks.name: HTTPS on All Sampled URLs
checks.description: All sampled URLs are requested and served over HTTPS.

checks.name: Valid SSL Certificate & TLS >= 1.2
checks.description: SSL certificate is valid, unexpired, and uses modern TLS 1.2 or 1.3.

checks.name: HTTP to HTTPS Single 301 Redirect
checks.description: Insecure HTTP requests redirect to HTTPS in a single clean 301 hop.

checks.name: No Insecure Mixed Content
checks.description: Share of page resources loaded securely without mixed active/passive content.

checks.name: Security Headers Hardening (HSTS/CSP)
checks.description: Presence of HSTS and security posture headers (modest weight, not direct ranking factor).

checks.name: Largest Contentful Paint (LCP p75)
checks.description: CrUX field LCP p75 (or lab Lighthouse fallback). Thresholds: 2.5s good, 4.0s poor.

checks.name: Interaction to Next Paint (INP p75)
checks.description: CrUX field INP p75. Thresholds: 200ms good, 500ms poor.

checks.name: Cumulative Layout Shift (CLS p75)
checks.description: CrUX field CLS p75. Thresholds: 0.10 good, 0.25 poor.

checks.name: Time to First Byte (TTFB p75)
checks.description: CrUX / server TTFB p75. Thresholds: 0.8s good, 1.8s poor.

checks.name: Valid Self-Referencing Canonical Tag
checks.description: Proportion of sampled URLs specifying a valid self-referencing canonical.

checks.name: Redirect Chains <= 1 Hop
checks.description: Proportion of redirecting links that resolve within 1 hop.

checks.name: Zero Broken Internal Links (4xx/5xx)
checks.description: 1 - (broken links / total internal links).

checks.name: Near-Duplicate Content Prevention
checks.description: Absence of duplicate content clusters with cosine similarity >= 0.95.

checks.name: Title Tag Present
checks.description: HTML <title> tag is present and non-empty.

checks.name: Title Length 30-60 Characters
checks.description: Title character length stays within 30-60 characters (approx <= 580px rendered width).

checks.name: Unique Titles Across Crawl Sample
checks.description: Share of unique title tags across crawled pages.

checks.name: Semantic Match to H1 and Page Topic
checks.description: Cosine similarity between Title and H1 is >= 0.60.

checks.name: Meta Description Present
checks.description: Meta description tag exists and is non-empty.

checks.name: Meta Description 70-160 Characters
checks.description: Character count stays within recommended snippet length (70-160 chars).

checks.name: Unique Descriptions Across Sample
checks.description: Share of unique meta descriptions across sampled pages.

checks.name: Exactly One Non-Empty H1
checks.description: Each crawled page contains exactly one non-empty H1 tag.

checks.name: Logical Heading Hierarchy (No Skipped Levels)
checks.description: Headings do not skip levels (e.g. H1 to H3 without H2).

checks.name: H1 Aligns with Page Intent
checks.description: H1 matches title intent and target query theme.

checks.name: Required Open Graph Tags Present
checks.description: og:title, og:type, og:image, og:url present on primary pages.

checks.name: Twitter Card Tag Present
checks.description: twitter:card tag declared.

checks.name: OG Image Reachable & Valid Dimensions
checks.description: OG image URL is reachable and recommended >= 1200x630 resolution.

checks.name: Descriptive Alt Text on Content Images
checks.description: Share of content images containing meaningful alt attributes.

checks.name: SERP Entity & Subtopic Coverage
checks.description: Weighted coverage of entities and subtopics present in top-10 SERP.

checks.name: Original Information Gain (Sentence Cosine < 0.80)
checks.description: Share of original sentences with max competitor cosine < 0.80.

checks.name: Supported Fact & Claim Rate (Wilson Lower Bound)
checks.description: Wilson lower bound of supported claims (numbers with units, named sources, original data).

checks.name: Author Byline, Credentials & Timestamp
checks.description: Explicit author byline, verifiable credentials, and published/updated dates.

checks.name: Outline Depth & Section Intent Coverage
checks.description: Heading depth and section coverage against query intent set.

checks.name: Zero URL Conflict Clusters
checks.description: 1 - (URLs in conflict clusters / URLs sampled). Flags cosine >= 0.85 with split impressions.

checks.name: Flesch Reading Ease in Target Band
checks.description: Scores Flesch against audience band (Consumer 60-80, B2B 30-60) with smooth decay.

checks.name: Average Sentence Length <= 25 Words
checks.description: Share of sentences containing 25 words or fewer.

checks.name: Paragraph Length <= 120 Words
checks.description: Share of paragraphs containing 120 words or fewer.

gates.reason: AI Search outcomes cannot be simulated without live engine query execution.

checks.name: Wilson Lower Bound Brand Mention Rate
checks.description: Wilson lower bound of brand mention rate across answering AI engines.

checks.name: Wilson Lower Bound Domain Citation Rate
checks.description: Wilson lower bound of own-domain citation link rate across AI answers.

checks.name: Fact Sheet Precision x Recall Score
checks.description: Comparison against ground-truth fact sheet via temperature 0.0 consensus LLM judge.

checks.name: 1 - Competitor Displacement Rate
checks.description: 1 - (prompts where >=1 competitor appears and brand is absent / prompts where any tracked brand appears).

checks.name: Mention Rate on Comparison & Pricing Prompts
checks.description: Mention rate on high-intent decision stage queries (comparison, pricing, best X for Y).

checks.name: Wikidata or Google Knowledge Graph Resolution
checks.description: Entity resolution in Wikidata or Google Knowledge Graph.

checks.name: SameAs Links Resolve & Reciprocate
checks.description: Declared sameAs URLs resolve with HTTP 200 and link back or verify entity.

checks.name: Brand Name Jaro-Winkler >= 0.92 Across Surfaces
checks.description: Brand naming consistency across homepage, about page, and schema.

checks.name: Category Embedding Agreement
checks.description: Self-stated category aligns with standard industry ontology.

checks.name: Canonical Definition in Top 100 Words
checks.description: Clear statement of what the company/product is within first 100 words of hero.

checks.name: Answers Fully Without Outside Context
checks.description: Mean score (0 / 0.5 / 1.0) across 8 buyer questions evaluated against site chunks via calibrated judge.

checks.name: Key Entity Facts in JSON-LD Match Visible Text
checks.description: Share of key entity facts (name, URL, logo, contact, description) that match visible text.

checks.name: Pricing, ICP, Integrations, Security Concrete Coverage
checks.description: Composite score of presence, concrete specifics, and cross-page consistency on commercial topics.

checks.name: Self-Contained Chunks Scoring >= 0.70
checks.description: Share of 100-300 token content passages scoring >= 0.70 on entity clarity and specific claims.

checks.name: AI Search Bots Allowed (OAI-SearchBot, PerplexityBot, Claude-SearchBot)
checks.description: RFC 9309 longest-match allows live search/user bots. (Training bot blocking is non-penalized).

checks.name: Main Content Present in Raw HTML (No JS Required)
checks.description: Share of primary text content rendered in initial HTML before client-side script execution.

gates.reason: Structured data contradicts visible on-page content, violating search engine trust guidelines.

checks.name: Organization Schema Completeness
checks.description: Share of required and recommended Organization properties per Google & Schema.org.

checks.name: Organization Schema Valid Syntax
checks.description: JSON-LD parses cleanly without schema syntax errors.

checks.name: Stable @id and Resolving SameAs
checks.description: Stable entity URI @id and valid resolving sameAs references.

checks.name: WebSite Name, AlternateName, and URL
checks.description: WebSite schema properly declared with name and URL.

checks.name: BreadcrumbList Matches Visible Trail
checks.description: BreadcrumbList valid and matching visible navigation on inner pages.

checks.name: Matching Schema per Template (Product/Article/Software)
checks.description: Specific matching schema type present with Google required fields.

checks.name: FAQPage Markup (Answer Engine Extractability)
checks.description: Valid FAQPage markup for answer engine extractability (modest weight).

checks.name: Verified Properties Match Text (Exact Numbers, String Fuzzy >= 0.90)
checks.description: (verified + 0.5 * partial) / stated properties compared to visible text.

checks.name: Hero Text Who, What, Why & Specificity Rubric
checks.description: Rubric scoring on above-the-fold hero messaging clarity and target audience specificity.

checks.name: Dominant CTA Above the Fold on Desktop & Mobile
checks.description: Clear primary CTA rendered above the fold at 1366x768 and 390x844.

checks.name: CTA Contrast >= 3:1 (WCAG 1.4.11)
checks.description: Button contrast meets WCAG non-text contrast threshold.

checks.name: Specific Action Verb Label
checks.description: CTA uses actionable, specific verb+object label.

checks.name: Clicks to Conversion <= 2
checks.description: Direct funnel path requires 2 or fewer clicks to conversion event.

checks.name: Field Count Curve (<=3 fields = 1.0, 8 = 0.5, 12+ = 0.2)
checks.description: Form field count scored via log-normal curve based on Baymard friction research.

checks.name: Programmatic Field Labels & Autocomplete
checks.description: All input fields have associated label tags and appropriate autocomplete attributes.

checks.name: Inline Error Validation & Clear Confirmation
checks.description: Form provides inline error hints and unambiguous submission feedback.

checks.name: Standard Viewport Meta Declared
checks.description: Meta viewport tag declared with width=device-width.

checks.name: No Horizontal Overflow at 360px Width
checks.description: Page layout renders without horizontal scroll at 360px viewport.

checks.name: Tap Targets >= 24x24px (WCAG 2.2 SC 2.5.8)
checks.description: Share of interactive buttons/links meeting minimum tap target dimensions.

checks.name: Base Body Font Size >= 16px
checks.description: Body text font size is at least 16 CSS px for mobile readability.

gates.reason: External authority and trust reviews are marked unmeasured without connected evidence.

checks.name: Bayesian Normalized Review Rating
checks.description: (C*m + sum(r)) / (C + n) from connected review platforms.

checks.name: Review Volume Scale min(1, log10(n+1)/3)
checks.description: Logarithmic scaling of review volume up to 1000+ reviews.

checks.name: Attributed Testimonials (Named Person & Company)
checks.description: On-page quotes and case studies attributed to verifiable individuals and companies.

checks.name: Privacy Policy & Terms of Service Linked
checks.description: Privacy policy and terms of service URLs exist and return HTTP 200.

checks.name: Compliance Claims Link to Verifiable Reports (SOC2/ISO)
checks.description: Security claims (SOC 2, ISO, HIPAA) link to active trust center or third-party report.

checks.name: Consent Mechanism (EU/UK Traffic)
checks.description: Cookie banner / consent management platform present if targeting regulated regions.

checks.name: Physical Address, Phone, Email & About Team Page
checks.description: Verified presence of corporate contact channels and about page.

checks.name: Official Corporate Registry Match
checks.description: Entity verified in state or national corporate registry (OpenCorporates, Companies House, SEC).

checks.name: 1 - (Unbacked Superlatives / Total Claims)
checks.description: Proportion of superlative claims backed by citation or empirical evidence.
